headline: Wayne Rooney blasts Man United players amid growing crisis
description: Manchester United's players need a "firework up their a----" and reminding what it means to play for the club, according to Wayne Rooney.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Real Madrid eye Liverpool's Alexis Mac Allister
description: Liverpool midfielder Alexis Mac Allister has admirers at Real Madrid, while the Reds line up potential replacements. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Gianluigi Donnarumma 'making mistakes,' defended by Man City boss Enzo Maresca
description: Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca has defended goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma and defender Marc Guéhi following criticism of their form.

headline: Liverpool 'optimistic' Florian Wirtz will be fit to face Chelsea
description: Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola has said he is "optimistic" Florian Wirtz will be fit to feature in Wednesday's Carabao Cup clash with Chelsea.

headline: Michael Carrick to lead Man United vs. Chelsea amid uncertain future - sources
description: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick took training on Tuesday and now expects to be in charge against Chelsea on Saturday, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Man United tight-lipped with Carrick back at Carrington on Tuesday
description: Michael Carrick has taken first-team training at Manchester United Tuesday despite ongoing uncertainty over his future as manager at Old Trafford.
